clues.text: Moses warned that if Israel disobeyed, these trees would fill their land, but the fruit would drop off unused.
When the trees sought a king in Jotham's story, this tree refused, unwilling to stop giving its oil.
In a vision, Zechariah saw two of these trees beside a solid gold lampstand, one on each side.
Paul told Gentile believers they were a wild shoot grafted into this tree to share its nourishing root.
On the night He was betrayed, Jesus went as usual to the mount named for these trees to pray.
In Ezra's day, Jerusalem's people were told to gather this tree's branches, with myrtle and palm, to build booths.
As the flood waters went down, a dove came back to Noah in the evening with a fresh leaf from this tree.

taken: Waiting for the waters to go down, he sent out a bird that came back at evening with a freshly plucked leaf.
In Ezra's day, people were told to fetch olive, myrtle and palm branches from the hill country to build these.
